title: Market volatility se bachne ka simple tarika?
body: Apne investments ko alag-alag assets jaise equity, gold, aur debt mein distribute karna hi Asset Allocation hai. Yeh aapke portfolio ko market ke utar-chadav se bachane mein madad karta hai. Sahi financial education ke sath soch-samajh kar invest karna hamesha samajhdari hai.
